title: Network Hardening Security Risk Assessment
context: Fixture derived from the Coursera exercise; the generator itself is scenario agnostic.

findings.title: Shared employee passwords
evidence: Course scenario states that employees share passwords.
findings.risk: A leaked credential can expose multiple accounts and weakens accountability.
findings.recommendation: Assign unique accounts and enforce a strong password policy with MFA.

findings.title: Default database administrator password
evidence: Course scenario states that the database administrator password remains default.
findings.risk: A known credential can provide privileged access to sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Replace the default secret with a managed unique credential and require MFA.
findings.cadence: Remediate immediately; rotate and audit regularly.
validation: Credential review confirms the default secret is inactive.

findings.title: Firewall rules absent for ingress and egress
evidence: Course scenario states that firewalls have no inbound or outbound filtering rules.
findings.risk: Unnecessary or malicious traffic can enter or leave the network.
findings.recommendation: Implement deny-by-default rules with documented exceptions.
findings.cadence: Review monthly and after network changes.
validation: Exported rules match approved network flows.

findings.title: Multifactor authentication not enabled
evidence: Course scenario states that MFA is not used.
findings.risk: A stolen password may be enough to access the network.
findings.recommendation: Require MFA for administrative and remote network access.
validation: MFA coverage report includes privileged users.
